text.tspan: The boundaries and names shown and the des
gnations used on this map do not imply official
endorsement or acceptance by the United Nati
ns. Dotted line represents approximately the
Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir agreed
pon by India and Pakistan. The final status of
Jammu and Kashmir has not yet been agreed
